# Precision MedTech Services, LLC

> Independent rehabilitation equipment service company in Clermont, Florida, owned and operated by Chris Senzamici. Specialized Biodex repair available nationwide; physical therapy and rehabilitation equipment service throughout Florida. 35+ years of field service experience.

## Who we serve
Professional sports teams (MLB and NFL), universities and athletic departments, hospitals and health systems, PT clinics and wellness centers, NASA and research facilities, and commercial gyms and strength facilities.

## Services
- [Biodex Repair](https://www.precisionmedtechservices.com/biodex-repair/): service for all Biodex physical medicine equipment: System 4 Pro/3/2, Balance System SD, BioSway, Gait Trainer 3, NxStep, FreeStep SAS, BioStep 2, Upper Body Cycle, Sit2Stand, Squat Assist
- [Rehab Equipment Service](https://www.precisionmedtechservices.com/rehab-equipment/): treadmills, steppers, cycles, strength equipment
- [Preventive Maintenance](https://www.precisionmedtechservices.com/preventive-maintenance/)
